label: qa-stag
tenant_id_source: fill in: the tenantId claim of your access token, read on a tablet with run.py's ACCOUNT_JS; null skips the tenant check
identity_check: runner: access token email hashed in the page == sha256(lower(QA_TEST_EMAIL)) from qa/secrets.env, and the token's tenantId claim == tenant_id; a mismatch blocks the run
note: Copy to qa/devices/accounts.v1.json and change label, id and tenant_id. label must equal "account" in qa/runner/engine.json.
